recentItems.title: LGE 2026 | ANC briefs media on decision to take IEC to Electoral Court over candidate lists
recentItems.description:
The ANC is set to brief the media on its decision to approach the courts over the IEC's handling of its candidate lists.

The party is challenging the Electoral Commission's decision regarding the submission of its candidates ahead of the upcoming elections. 

SABC News reporter, Samkele Maseko is on the story. Lets cross to him live

media on its decision to challenge the IEC in court over the handling of its candidate lists

recentItems.title: Court Clash: Police Block Matlala and Co-Accused From Consulting
recentItems.description:
A verbal altercation ensued in court after police did not allow Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala and his co-accused to consult in court. The judge has since ordered that police should allow the accused to consult during the court day. 

Matlala and co-accused are on trial for the attempted murder of socialite Tebogo Thobejane, businessman Joe Sibanyoni and music producer Seunkie Mokubung

recentItems.title: Rooigrond Correctional Centre escape may have been an inside job
recentItems.description:
Correctional Services National Commissioner Makgothi Thobakgale suspects that convicted criminal Edward Khomotso Madiba’s second escape from custody may have been an inside job.

Thobakgale conducted an inspection at Rooigrond Correctional Centre in Mahikeng in the North West on Tuesday, following Madiba’s escape on Sunday.

recentItems.title: Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala and co-accused back in court
recentItems.description:
A new state witness is expected to take the stand in the trial of alleged criminal kingpin Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala and four co-accused

in the High Court in Johannesburg today.

The accused face charges of attempted murder, conspiracy to commit murder and money laundering.
The State prosecutor is confident that the state's case in the trial within a trial will be concluded  this week.

recentItems.title: Vusumuzi 'Cat' Matlala and co-accused back in court | 08 September 2026
recentItems.description:
The High Court in Johannesburg is expected to continue with a trial within a trial today in the attempted murder case involving alleged underworld figure Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala and four co-accused. 

Matlala is accused of orchestrating three failed assassination attempts targeting his former girlfriend, Tebogo Thobejane, businessman Joe Sibanyoni and music producer Seunkie Mokubung, better known as DJ Vettys.

recentItems.title: Tulbagh canning factory workers at risk of losing their jobs
recentItems.description:
Seasonal workers at the Tulbagh canning factory in the Western Cape are fearing the loss of their jobs, saying it will plunge them further into poverty. The company, Premier Group, is meeting with workers' representatives today in a second CCMA- facilitated process
